description: Get platform statistics including total process count, registered capabilities, and discovery service health. Use this for questions like 'how many processes?', 'what capabilities are available?', or 'platform statistics'.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Health status with keys: is_healthy (boolean service status), total_processes (count of registered processes), total_usage_records (usage tracking count), index_last_built (timestamp of last index rebuild)
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Determine the appropriate next action based on the context and action result.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Retrieves health metrics and statistics from the discovery service including process counts and index status
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: ConnectionError: Discovery service or its dependencies unavailable. TimeoutError: Health check took too long, service may be overloaded.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: For connection errors: Service may be starting up, suggest waiting and retrying. For timeout: Service may be under heavy load, suggest trying again later.
